name: Cut-Paper Title Sequence
summary: Mid-century opening titles: sliding paper bars, a hand-cut zigzag pulse and a torn bar that falls away as the anomaly.
look: Flat coral, teal, cream and near-black fields with hand-cut paper shapes whose edges wobble. Jaunty word-by-word Manrope 800 titles, one serif italic word, and tracked uppercase credit captions.

components.name: Cut-paper strip
components.role: rectangles with jittered 28 px edges — bars, rules, buttons

components.name: Zigzag pulse strip
components.role: one paper cut-out forming the heartbeat line

components.name: Jaunty title words
components.role: each word rotated ±2.5° and offset ±6 px

components.name: Credits caption
components.role: tracked uppercase Manrope 600 in title-card style

components.name: Torn bar
components.role: the anomaly: a bar ripped in two, top piece falling in coral

components.name: Paper disc
components.role: hand-cut circle for the coral dot or accents

motion.name: Stop-motion hold
motion.how: animate on 2s or 3s (12 or 8 fps) with 1–2 px jitter per frame to sell hand-made paper

motion.name: Slide & snap
motion.how: strips slide from off-frame, power2.out 0.3 s, then a 3-frame overshoot, one per 8th note

motion.name: Tear & tumble
motion.how: torn piece rotate 0→24° and y +120 px, power2.in 0.5 s; tear lands on a downbeat with a paper-rip SFX

story: Hook: black paper bars slide over a coral field as "How many dashboards did you check today?" jolts in. Reveal: the bars snap into one zigzag paper pulse line, coral dot, "Acme presents … Pulse". Proof: a paper bar chart where the checkout bar tears and falls, −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231, a paper arrow points to the teal Roll back strip. CTA: "You ship. Pulse watches." with a teal Start free strip and credit line.
adapt: Rebuild your product's key chart or UI element as paper cut-outs and let the moment your product acts be a single cut, tear or snap. Your CTA becomes the final credit card.

references.note: Art of the Title: Saul Bass title sequences (The Man with the Golden Arm, Anatomy of a Murder, Vertigo)
Bass's cut-paper animation and kinetic typography

fit.risk: Retro pastiche if overdone; jittery edges on data can look sloppy at small sizes.
